_doc: AI Prompt Templates — auto-compose image generation prompts from prop metadata. Every placeholder resolves from spawn() output. Templates are per-face (front/side/top) for UV mapping.
_base_prompt: {art_style}, {face} view of a {prop_desc}, {dimensions}, {material_desc}, {condition_desc}, {category_style}, {detail_level}, game asset, clean edges, {background}

detail_level.epic: rich detail with reflections and micro-texture

_face_templates.front: {art_style}, front view of a {prop_desc}, {w}x{h}cm, {material_desc}, {condition_desc}, {category_style}, {detail_level}, game asset, clean edges, {background}
_face_templates.side: {art_style}, side view of a {prop_desc}, {d}x{h}cm, {material_desc}, {condition_desc}, {category_style}, {detail_level}, game asset, clean edges, {background}
_face_templates.top: {art_style}, top-down view of a {prop_desc}, {w}x{d}cm, {material_desc}, {condition_desc}, {category_style}, {detail_level}, flat lay, {background}

_material_descriptions.luxury: {color} polished lacquered surface with subtle sheen
_material_descriptions.military: {color} matte painted metal with stenciled markings
_material_descriptions.nautical: {color} weathered painted wood with salt residue

_condition_descriptions.used: slightly worn, minor scuffs, lived-in feel
_condition_descriptions.damaged: dents, cracks, rust spots, missing parts
_condition_descriptions.ruined: heavily destroyed, broken, covered in grime and corrosion

_category_styles.slum: cyberpunk slum aesthetic, neon-lit grime, makeshift repairs
_category_styles.corp: sleek corporate minimalism, glass and chrome, sterile white
_category_styles.military: tactical military style, olive drab, utilitarian design
_category_styles.docks: maritime industrial, rope and rust, salt-weathered
_category_styles.lab: clean laboratory aesthetic, clinical white, biosafety markings

barrel.water: large water collection barrel with tap

god._doc: Overhead God Mode — Project Zomboid style. Tiny icons through transparent walls.
god.prompt_style: 1-bit pixel icon {w}x{h}px, top-down silhouette of a {prop_desc}, {material_desc}, black outline, {background}

room._doc: First-Person Room Mode — click to enter. AI textures at rarity-based resolution.

card._doc: Inspect Card Mode — double-click prop. Bestiario-style stat card with hero pixel art.
card.prompt_style: detailed pixel art portrait of a {prop_desc}, {material_desc}, {condition_desc}, {category_style}, centered composition, dramatic lighting, RPG item card illustration, {background}
